change and suggest the suitable instructions that can be used for both?
. Compare the two posters. Which among the two posters do you think has given more

Use of Language
Modal Verbs
When suggesting oradvising:
When someone wants to recommend or suggest, you use the modal verb should.
Examples
. You should try travelling on the new airline. It offers a comfortable travel.
. The old man should avoid travelling in a rickshaw. It is difficult for him to sit in it.
When giving a command:
On the other hand, when someone wants to command someone, they use the modal
verbs must, have to, or need to.
Example
. You must catch the 8'O clock bus to reach lslamabad on time.
. You need to be here before 10:00 am in the morning, else you will miss your flight.
Obligation ornecessity:
Likewise, the negative form expresses that an action is not necessary. Use the same modal
verbs as with commands: must, have to, or need to.
Example
. We have to wait for our train to arrive as it was four hours late.
. You don't need to come if you don't want to.
